Rates use each loop’s scheduled runs. Changes compare the periods shown above.
Not enough comparable records (at least 5 runs in each period).
Resumed the next day: %1$d of %2$d opportunities
After a day with scheduled runs but no completions, the next scheduled calendar day had a completion. An unfinished today is not counted as a failed restart.
Valid time records: %1$d of %2$d completed runs
Note icon: a note is available · blank: no completion

Completion = completed runs / scheduled runs. Skipped, unrecorded and in-progress runs remain in the denominator. Disabled runs and future dates are excluded; today’s scheduled runs are included. Saved history takes priority. If a historical record is missing, the current schedule is used to reconstruct it; changing a schedule can change these estimates.

Completed months compare their full periods. The current month compares equal elapsed day counts with the previous month, shortened to the shorter month if needed. The comparison dates are shown. A missing previous record is not treated as 0%. Differences are percentage points (pp).

Only completed runs with valid recorded start and end times contribute to recorded time. Overnight runs are handled across midnight. Missing times are excluded; scheduled duration is not substituted. Overlapping loops are added separately.
Active day: at least one completed run. All-complete day: every scheduled run completed. Longest streak: consecutive calendar days with a completion within the selected month.

Weekday highlights require at least 3 scheduled days and 5 runs, with two comparable weekdays. Loop changes require at least 5 runs in each period plus saved previous-period records. Patterns describe observations, not causes.
